title: The Hawk Court Compendium of the Cord
summary: A court compendium of the hawk's wait and stoop applied to the cord, ending in the court's judgement stoop.

title: Manual of the Twin Basin Orbit
summary: Teaches twin weights turned in opposed orbits like water in a basin, up to a sweep that overflows the rim.

title: Treatise of Paired Azure Weights
summary: Sets out the pair of weights thrown under the azure sky, from the plain draw to a lattice of cords and a vanishing step.

title: River Court Mastery of the Pair
summary: Teaches paired cords worked like the courts of a river, binding a foe in the current and finishing with a flood.

title: The Dual-Track Cord Canon
summary: The kingdom's dual-track canon applied to the bolas, two cords on two lines that join in one capture.

title: Manual of the Azure Descent
summary: Trains the thrower to lift the weights high and bring them down on a target with the force of a falling hawk.

title: Canon of the Wind-Sworn Reach
summary: A canon of long wind-fed casts sworn to a bearing, ending in a cast that the wind itself seems to guide.

title: Plateau Oath Course of the Weights
summary: Teaches the oath of the plateau runner applied to cord and weight, from the open stance to a held snare.

title: Treatise of the Unwalled Bearing
summary: Teaches a thrower to hold a bearing on open ground with no walls to lean on, up to a sweeping capture.

title: Manual of the Gale-Carried Cord
summary: Teaches the cord to ride the gale, from the leaning stance to a cast that curves around any guard.

title: Oath and Horizon Compendium
summary: A compendium of sworn throws made at the far horizon, from sighting the quarry to the oath-bound capture.

title: The Long Bearing Canon of the Plateau
summary: The fullest Gale canon of the cord, holding a bearing across the whole plateau and binding what crosses it.
